items.b: SCS RETIRES SCS-007, THE GEMSTONE STANDARD NO MINER ADOPTED
items.t: The scheme covered natural and laboratory-grown diamonds, emeralds, rubies and sapphires and ended on 1 September. Certificates already issued run to their expiry date.

items.b: SILVER FIXES AT $67.035 IN LONDON, HIGHEST SINCE 28 AUGUST
items.t: The fix rose 4.54% on Thursday's $64.125 while Kitco's close fell 1.06% to $66.127, leaving spot 1.35% below the fix.

items.b: NOONANS LISTS TWO MEDIEVAL GOLD RINGS AT £9,000 TO £13,000
items.t: Andrew Riley found both near Northallerton in 2024, four months apart. The sale is on 22 September and neither ring has a result yet.

items.b: BOTSWANA'S GAOLATHE TIES LAB-GROWN'S RISE TO DE BEERS DOUBT
items.t: The vice president spoke at Chatham House on 17 September. Anglo American is selling its 85% stake and Botswana holds the other 15%.

items.b: WATCHES AND WONDERS ADDS 9 BRANDS TO ITS 2027 ROSTER
items.t: Thirteen new exhibitors are now confirmed, including Porsche Design and Berneron. The salon runs 5 to 11 April 2027.
